title: 第191章森林深处第190章被封印的仙石
slug: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
第191章森林深处
郁凡的速度很快。
大罗金仙的实力让他在飞行上面速度增快了不少。
然而仙草种植所在的方向却要经过那片森林。
正是在那森林的深处。
郁凡已经能够猜测到那块地方应该是有强悍的仙兽守护着的。
他现在的实力也不知道能够走到森林的什么地方。
现在手上没有什么好东西，可以让那些仙兽主动退步。
不一会儿郁凡已经落在了森林入口前。
白澈自然是跟在身后的。
“凡哥，我们是不是要杀进去啊？”
白策觉得若是一路杀过去，那得死多少仙兽。
作为一个仙兽，他自然是不希望这片森林里有大量同类的死亡。
虽然他们在争斗的时候经常会出现伤亡，但是弱肉强食是不管是在仙界还是在凡界，都是属于一个本能了。
仙兽之间可以互相伤害，却不希望其他的种族伤害到仙兽们。
郁凡自然知道白澈不希望伤害到仙兽的意思。
“放心，除非他们主动对我们动手，否则我是不会杀了他们的。”
他自然也不希望这些仙兽们耽误他太长的时间，他现在只想赶紧找到那一片仙草，将自己所需要的药材都收集起来。
他现在只想迫不及待的炼制真正的仙丹。
白澈沉默了一瞬，他自然知道郁凡直接闯入森林必然是会被人仙兽攻击的。

仙兽的领地意识强，但凡进入领地的在他们看来都是来攻击他们的。
正因为如此郁凡直接进入森林，不可能完全不闯入到其他仙兽的领域中。
“我会收敛住自己的气息。”
郁凡自然明白仙兽的领域意识这个问题，不仅仅是仙兽，在曾经去过的异世界大陆中妖兽也是一样的。
仙兽想必也是如此，他早已做好了准备。
所以他一开始就打算直接隐藏住自己的身形，进入其中。
白澈这才明白郁凡的打算。
他有想法跟进去，然而他身上的鸟类仙兽气息太强烈了，根本就无法掩盖住自己。
郁凡也看出了白澈的为难，便体贴的说道：“我一个人进去便好，你先去帮我守护住那一片矿石。”
他在来之前便已经叫了红色巨石怪物过来帮助开采那些仙石矿了。
白澈自然明白郁凡的想法，必然是为了能够保护自己。
他眉头一皱说道：“可是你一个人进去实在是太危险了。”
白澈在这里生活了如此多年，但他始终不敢前往森林深处，他不知道那里究竟有什么，但却能感受到那里散发出来的阴寒之气，让他不敢靠近里面一步。
“我一个人会更加安全一点，因为我可以隐藏住自己的气息。”
说着郁凡便将自己的气息全部收敛。
白澈惊讶的发现他居然感知不到郁凡的存在了。
“这个好厉害！”白澈忍不住感叹道。
居然会有如此术法的存在，能够收敛住自己所有的气息，这样进入别人的地盘也察觉不出来。
他也总算是放下了一颗心。
如果一路避开所有的仙兽，自然不会出现有仙兽的伤亡，对于他来说也比较能够接受。

而郁凡也不会受伤。
白澈也不再纠结这些，干脆的说道：“那凡哥我就在那仙石矿那里为你守住那个石矿了，我等着你回来。”
content_en:
Chapter 191 Deep in the Forest
Yu Fan is very fast.
Daluo Jinxian's strength made him fly a lot faster.
However, the direction where the fairy grass is planted has to pass through the forest.
It was deep in that forest.
Yu Fan could already guess that that place should be guarded by powerful immortal beasts.
With his current strength, he doesn't know where he can go in the forest.
There is nothing good at hand now that can make those fairy beasts take the initiative to retreat.
After a while, Yu Fan had landed in front of the entrance of the forest.
Bai Che naturally followed behind.
"Brother Fan, are we going to fight in?"
Bai Ce felt that if he killed them all the way, how many immortal beasts would die.
As a fairy beast, he naturally does not want a large number of his kind to die in this forest.
Although they often suffer casualties when fighting, the law of the jungle is an instinct whether it is in the fairy world or the mortal world.
Fairy beasts can hurt each other, but they don't want other races to hurt the fairy beasts.
Yu Fan naturally knew that Bai Che didn't want to harm the fairy beast.
"Don't worry, I won't kill them unless they take the initiative to attack us."
Naturally, he didn't want these fairy beasts to delay him for too long. Now he just wanted to quickly find the piece of fairy grass and collect all the medicinal materials he needed.
Now he just wants to refine the real elixir.
Bai Che was silent for a moment. He naturally knew that Yu Fan would definitely be attacked by human beings and beasts if he broke into the forest directly.
Fairy beasts have a strong sense of territory, and anyone who enters their territory seems to them to be attacking them.
Because of this, it was impossible for Yu Fan to enter the forest directly without intruding into the realm of other immortal beasts.
"I'll hold my breath back."
Yu Fan naturally understands the issue of the domain awareness of fairy beasts. It is not just fairy beasts, but also the monster beasts in the other world continents he has been to.
The same must be true for the immortal beast, he has already been prepared.
So he planned to hide his figure directly from the beginning and enter it.
Only then did Bai Che understand Yu Fan's plan.
He had the idea to follow, but the aura of birds and immortal beasts on his body was too strong, and he couldn't cover himself up at all.
Yu Fan also saw Bai Che's dilemma, and said considerately: "I can go in alone. You go and help me protect the ore first."
Before he came, he had already called the red boulder monster to help mine the fairy stone mines.
Bai Che naturally understood that Yu Fan's thoughts must be to protect himself.
He frowned and said, "But it's too dangerous for you to go in alone."
Bai Che has lived here for so many years, but he has never dared to go to the depths of the forest. He didn't know what was there, but he could feel the cold air emanating from there, which made him dare not take a step closer.
"I'm safer on my own because I can hide my scent."
As he spoke, Yu Fan restrained all his breath.
Bai Che was surprised to find that he could no longer sense Yu Fan's presence.
"This is so awesome!" Bai Che couldn't help but sigh.
There is actually such a magic that can contain all of one's aura, so that one cannot even notice when one enters other people's territory.
He finally let go of his heart.
If he avoids all the immortal beasts along the way, there will naturally be no casualties from the immortal beasts, which is more acceptable to him.
And Yu Fan will not be injured.
Bai Che no longer struggled with this and said simply: "Brother Fan, I will guard the fairy stone mine for you. I will wait for you to come back."
